change_summary: Idempotent same-signal-day pending admission (subtract pending_for_asof from daily_entry_slots) in alpha_score_market_regime_paper_sleeve.py + report_generator.py now renders an explicit Pending queue block so state.json pending and the daily report cannot disagree. Root cause: 6/30 signal processed twice (03:43Z, 05:06Z); run1 captured CAT rank1 into pending, run2 granted a fresh daily slot to GEV. Paper-only, trade_enabled=False, no live order path touched.
changed_variable: idempotent same-day pending admission + report renders true pending queue
hypothesis: Same-signal-day re-runs of the alpha_score_market_regime paper sleeve accumulate multiple pending entries beyond daily_entry_slots, and the daily report renders new-candidates-this-run instead of the actual pending queue, so state.json pending and the report disagree (CAT appears in state pending but not in the 6/30 report).
notes: Repro: state pending=CAT+GEV vs report shows GEV only. Data-timing/backfill hypothesis DISPROVEN (identical universe+scores across both runs; CAT is a legit rank-1). New test: test_same_signal_day_rerun_is_idempotent_and_does_not_double_admit. 6 sleeve tests + 24 report-touching tests pass.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The sleeve's capacity math (min(room, daily_entry_slots)) was stateless w.r.t. the same signal day, so a second same-day run granted a fresh daily slot to the next-ranked candidate after the top pick was already captured into pending; the report rendered the new-this-run candidate shortlist rather than the persisted pending queue, so a captured buy (CAT) vanished from the operator report while staying in state.json.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not re-tune daily_entry_slots, max_active_positions, top-decile threshold, or add a second dedup path; the fix is the pending_for_asof subtraction + pending-queue render. Do not hand-edit live paper state to remove the stale GEV pending (races the auto-committer).
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Only reopen if a real double-admit recurs after the guard (would indicate created_asof missing on entries) or if another paper sleeve shows the same report-vs-state divergence (same fix pattern applies).
